Mumbai under heatwave warning for second time this month; IMD forecasts hot and humid weather in city, parts of Maharashtra
The Santacruz observatory recorded a maximum temperature of 38.2 degrees Celsius on October 12, which was 5.1 degrees Celsius above normal, while Colaba recorded 36.5 degrees Celsius, 3.9 degrees Celsius above normal, weather scientist K.S. Hosalikar said
The previous heatwave alert was issued on October 9. Representational Pic/File
Mumbai is under a heatwave warning for the second time this month, with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasting hot and humid conditions across parts of the Konkan region on Monday and Tuesday, an evening weather bulletin said.
The previous heatwave alert was issued on October 9.
